verdict.rationale: Crossplane's own control plane runs continuously in the background. It automatically corrects drift from the desired state (crossplane-docs-18) and executes user-configured function pipelines that return declarative configuration it applies (crossplane-docs-32). A community user also notes it 'runs a control plane for enforcement' (crossplane-comm-11). However, this is reconciliation of declared resources rather than general-purpose automations a user sets up to run autonomously, so it covers only part of the story. Missing for 10: arbitrary or scheduled automation workflows beyond resource reconciliation, documentation of AI-driven background tasks, and hands-on corroboration of autonomous automation setups.
